clips.title: The story
paras: Across from the Stoutlager Inn in Thelsamar, Mountaineer Kadrell keeps watch over Loch Modan.

Mountaineer Kadrell keeps watch in Thelsamar and organizes the dwarven defenses of Loch Modan. Outposts along the valley’s fringes face pressure from troggs, gnolls, and native beasts. From the center of town, Kadrell organizes reinforcements, relays orders, and weighs reports from scouts in the field.

Mountaineer Kadrell keeps in touch with Thelsamar’s remote forward posts. He coordinates with Mountaineer Stormpike and sends adventurers to report to sentries such as Mountaineer Rockgar. The outposts guard the mountain passes, and Kadrell helps get them supplies, reinforcements, and word of threats.
